inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.116: &oSome trees (or tree-like things, like Coral) do not drop Saplings, but grow continuously in Bonsai Pots.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.118: Nothing I love more than a quaint volcano lair
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.119: It seems fishing in Lava works somewhat similarly to fishing in Water. Cast the hook, wait for a bite, and reel it in.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.120: Like the living world, fishing has a chance of grabbing both &cjunk&r and &6treasures&r. It also seems that &bthe biome is a factor&r in what is gathered.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.121: On the left, I've listed all the different &bJunk&r that can be found, as well as their biomes. On the right, I've done the same for &bTreasures&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.123: What I wouldn't give for a glass of ice water...
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.124: While my first attempts at siphoning water to this realm have been failures, I know success is right around the corner. It turns out my minions can emulate a form of water in their building and as such I've stabilized some in the Fisher's Hut as an experiment.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.125: Once my minions have created a stable source of water via a &6Fisher's Hut&r, my magic will &6allow my Fishing Rod to access my normal reality&r through this psuedo water.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.126: Unfortunately, I can't choose where I fish from or what biome my lure will end up in. I'll take what I can get though.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.127: I've cataloged lists of &6treasures, junks, and the rest&r that I can find.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.133: The disorganized, vein-like appearance of the wood here is the opposite of appealing. I can scrape the &bTree Bark&r off with an Axe, which has the added benefit that it can be made into Paper.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.134: I can also use a &6Cutting Board&r instead. I've made a rudimentary contraption to do the work for me, stored in this Capsule.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.135: I suspect many other things could be similarly automated on this cutting board.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.138: When a Lava source makes contact with Water, it converts into &bObsidian&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.139: Water does not last long here, at least when placed by me. I'll have to &6make a canal from the Fisher's Hut&r, to preserve the original sources.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.142: Many of the varied resources I will need to obtain to make my escape are scattered throughout the land.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.143: Sure, I can explore manually and my map does a great job of charting the biomes I've visited but sometimes I just need a specific terrain.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.144: By creating a biome compass I can channel my magic into pinpointing exactly where the resources are, saving me much frustration in the days to come.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.145: But Not a Drop to Drink
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.147: Now that I have a stable source of &bWater&r from the &6Fisher's Hut&r, I can &6siphon little amounts using Bottles&r to not disturb the source block.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.148: I can then &6drain these Bottles in the Smeltery&r, where the Water is protected from their environment.
inferno_quests.chapters.resource_gen.149: From there, I can simply &6cast the Water into an empty Bucket&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.5: This world taxes the living to the point of breaking. There is no rest to be had here and wounds refuse to heal.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.6: &cNatural healing is much slower&r but the living can &6find respite in the warmth of a Campfire&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.7: Eternal darkness fills every crevice of this realm. Among my "friend's" parting gifts is a &6Glowing Mushroom&r, which can be held or worn to light my surroundings.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.14: This chapter will serve to &blist blocks useful for base-building&r that I've come across my time here.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.15: These quests are not in any particular order, and may be visible way before you can actually get them.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.16: The World Over In An Instant
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.18: Travel here is dangerous and time-consuming. As awe-inspiring as these alien vistas are, I simply cannot afford to explore.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.19: As such, I've devised a series of &6miniature teleportation circles&r, which I'm dubbing &bTravel Anchors&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.20: To use the Anchor, I have to name it and stand on another. I will be able to see it, even through walls, and right-clicking will teleport me to it.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.22: The &bDiamond Magnum Torch&r will &6prevent monsters from spawning in a large radius&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.23: I get my first one upon starting my colony, but additional ones must be crafted by an Enchanter.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.25: The &bInterdiction Torch&r is repulsive to non-humans. They are &6pushed away&r, and kept at least 4 blocks away.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.27: &bIron Grates&r will support myself and any other mobs, but will &6allow items to pass through&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.29: &cFire&r, it seems, is incredibly common here. While the locals do not mind, I do.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.30: There are several &bfireproof woods&r I can use in building. Of course, I could use things other than wood.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.33: &bElevators&r harness the Endermen's power of teleportation, without requiring an Ender Pearl every time.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.34: &6Jumping&r on one teleports me to another above, and &6sneaking&r does the opposite.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.37: The &bExperience Obelisk&r allows me to &6store experience in liquid form&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.38: It can also &6pick up experience orbs&r in the world.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.40: &bGlowcrystals&r will &6light up a large area&r, removing the need to place Torches everywhere.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.41: I can stack up to 4 Crystals together, lighting a 50x50 meter area.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.42: Glowcrystals work by placing invisible light sources every 3 blocks (two empty blocks between). This &cmay interfere with certain things&r, and multiblocks like the Smeltery.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.44: The &bShifting Sundial&r allows me to &6change the time&r! Especially useful as I am unable to sleep here.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.47: The &eChipped&r &bTables&r allow me to &6create thousands of decorative block variations&r
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.52: &bBurning Blossoms&r can be found throughout the Nether, as well as certain building plans.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.53: Though my &6minions are fire-proof&r, they still &cpanic anyway&r. I can avoid this by placing Trapdoors or other obstacles above the flower.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.56: One of the largest challenges I face here are &cconstant attacks from monsters&r, coming at me from all directions.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.57: While I can prevent them with a &6Magnum Torch&r, what if I could harness them instead?
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.58: Killing an entity with a &bSoul Shard&r in my inventory will bind it to that entity. Killing more of that enemy type adds their souls to the Shard. &6The more souls, the higher the tier.&r
inferno_quests.chapters.sanctuary.59: I can insert this Shard into a &bSoul Cage&r, which will &6spawn forth a limitless amount of that entity&r. The higher the tier, the more control I have, as well as mobs spawning more often and in greater numbers.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.1: Sanguine Sting
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.4: Darkness empowered with former life, the &bDark Power Gem&r allows for even stronger magical items.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.7: &4Life Essence.&r The very Will that pulses through everything that has ever, or will ever live.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.8: I admit, it's darker magic than I'm used to. However, stuck in this hellhole as I am, there's little I won't resort to.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.9: I can &6subject living creatures to my Smeltery&r to extract their blood. Alloying that with Soul Sand will create &cLife Essence&r, enough to create a &bBlood Altar&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.1: &oRemember, &6Dante's Divine Labram&r&o has all the guide books in it.&r
Just a Small Prick...
Make a Sacrificial Knife
With the Altar constructed, I can bloodlet in a more controlled manner using a &bSacrificial Knife&r.
It still hurts, but a &6Campfire&r nearby will help ease the pain.
Make an Alchemy Table
At the &bAlchemy Table&r, I can use LP from my Orb network to perform alchemy, providing &6unique recipes&r.
Twisting the Essence of Life
From the ash rises life.
&bArcane Ashes&r act as a conduit for a tiny amount of life energy. Enough to &6transmute physical objects&r from one form to another.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.2: This works somewhat similar to the Spiritfire from so long ago. This process slowly consumes the Ashes, but I can create a great many things from it.
&oUnlocks part of the chapter &5Sinful Sorcery&r&o under &3Mephistopheles' Anger&r
Make a Tier II Blood Altar
Greater powers require I corrupt my soul beyond what I'm currently able to. I need to &bupgrade my Blood Altar&r.
Encircling the Blood Altar with a ring of &bRunes&r will take it to Tier 2.
The exact specifications can be seen in the &6Sanguine Scientiem&r, in my &oDivine Libram.
The human body can only hold so much blood. At least, without some rather unfortunate leakage at inopportune times.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.3: To remedy this, I've designed the &bBlood Orb&r, an &6extradimensional pocket&r to contain blood! Of course, I have to provide said blood myself. For now.
I cannot create the Orb on my own. I need to &6teach it to my Enchanter&r, and then &6request it from a Postbox&r.
A Sound Mind, and a Sound Body
By infusing mundane String with Life Essence, I've managed to create a &bSnare&r capable of &6weakening the spirit&r of hostile creatures.
It &cisn't always effective&r, but when the Snare's curse takes hold, white particles will indicate a soul ready for harvest.
Upon their demise, the &6Demonic Will&r of the creature will remain.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.4: Blood Magic requires a sacrifice, but it &4doesn't have to be me&r.
With the &bDagger of Sacrifice&r, I can &6use the blood of others&r instead of my own to power my magics.
Unfortunately, it looks like I &ccan only sacrifice the innocent&r: animals, people, and the like. I suppose it's not much of a sacrifice if it's self-defense.

In order to increase the storage and power of magics I can work with blood magic I'll need a more suitable focus. The apprentice blood orb can be crafted using a sphere of empowered darkness and should fit my needs nicely.
With the &bApprentice Blood Orb&r, I've &6quintupled its LP storage&r, to a new maximum of 25,000.
Make a Tier III Blood Altar
The &bTier III Blood Altar&r has spots for &628 Runes&r, 20 more than the previous tier.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.5: It also allows for more powerful recipes.
Make a Tier IV Blood Altar
The &bTier IV Blood Altar&r has spots for &656 Runes&r, 28 more than the previous tier.
With it comes much more powerful items and rituals.
Make a Tier V Blood Altar
The &bTier V Blood Altar&r has spots for &6108 Runes&r, 56 more than the previous tier.
This tier is the pinnacle. There is no blood magic stronger than this.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.6: &6Rituals&r consume my LP to perform a variety of tasks.
Rituals are created by placing a &bMaster Ritual Stone&r, placing Runes in a specific arrangement (preferably using a &6Ritual Diviner&r), and then using an &bActivation Crystal&r on it.
Only the most important Rituals will be noted here. For the rest, I can read the &6Sanguine Scientiem&r.
In my experiments with leaving this realm, I've attempted to pierce through using Blood Magic.
I've managed to create the &bEdge of the Hidden Realm&r ritual. However, instead of taking me &oout&r, it's taken me &ceven deeper in&r.
It seems they were prepared for me here as well. There are locked doors requiring &6Iron Keys&r to pass through, and strong enemies to fight.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.7: There's &6good loot&r to be had though, and the way back is unbarred. I'll foresee myself making return trips.
&cI have to redo the ritual to visit a new dungeon.&r Each Pillar opens the same dungeon.
The &6strongest rituals&r require Dusk Runes, which requires the &bInscription Tool: Dusk&r.
One such ritual is the &4Well of Suffering&r. This terrible ritual &6slowly saps the life force&r of all things within its boundaries, &6converting it to LP&r to fill a Blood Altar.
Incredibly powerful when used in conjunction with Soul Cages.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.8: The &bMagician's Blood Orb&r has a &6max storage of 150,000 LP&r.
The &bMaster Blood Orb&r has a &6max storage of 1,000,000 LP&r.
While exploring the Antechamber, I've come across some sprigs of &bTau Fruit&r.
When I tried eating some, I discovered &4the juice inside was blood&r. Not very appetizing, for much more than the occasional snack at least.
Tau, as well as &bSaturated Tau&r, are &6very useful in certain recipes&r however.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.9: At the &bAlchemic Reaction Chamber&r, I can safely perform important alchemic reactions.
At the Alchemic Reaction Chamber, I'm able to purify Saturated Tau into &bWeak Blood Shards&r.
The &bMaster Blood Orb&r has a &6max storage of 10,000,000 LP&r.
The &6Pathway to the Endless Realm&r ritual takes me to a deeper level of the Dungeon. &cMuch more dangerous&r, but with &6much greater rewards&r.
In some chests, I can find the &6Foreman's Key&r, which is required to enter &6The Mines&r. Here I can find a new ore, &bDemonite&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.1: &bSigils&r are magic items that &6draw LP to perform functions&r.
The &6Sanguine Scientiem&r has a full list of their capabilities.
Sigils
Senketsu
Make a set of Living Armor
Though it was a bit awkward at the start, &bLiving Armor&r is fully subservient to me, obeying my every command.
As I wear it, it helps me become &6better at everything I do&r. Depending on the actions I take, it gains &6Upgrades&r. I can see the full list of upgrades in the &6Sanguine Scientiem&r.
Evil Potential
Make Empowered Inverted Potentia
By combining some mundane materials with a bit of Glowstone, I've created a &6Potentia Sphere&r, a great conductor of magic.
In this form, it's not very useful to me. Surrounding it in Dark Gems and then &6striking it with Lightning&r will create an &bEmpowered Inverted Potentia&r, much more useful.
The &bLightning Grenade&r will allow me to call lightning, even without clouds.
Thunder Struck
Get a Thunderstruck Weather Controller
At the temple I originally woke up in, there is a &6curious beam of energy&r.
At first, I was clueless to its purpose. I've come to understand that it's coming from an &6Environmental Accumulator&r, and echoes the weather.
Here, there is only one weather — that is, none. No weather &ois&r a weather though, and can be collected in the &bWeather Container&r by throwing it into the beam.
I can use this Clear Weather bottle to create Rainy and Stormy bottles.
I See You!
Make a Vengeance Ring
The &bVengeance Ring&r will allow me to &6see the spirits of those who've recently passed&r.
It won't let me fight back, unfortunately.
I can activate the ring to &6gain powers&r. However, this &ccauses more Vengeance Spirits to spawn&r.
Did Something Just Hit Me?
Vengeance Spirits
After killing my first creature here, I was was &bhurt by some intangible force&r.
I assumed it was something like guilt, but it keeps happening.
It appears that, on death, &6some part of them stays on&r. At least, for a time. I suppose they don't appreciate being killed.
Maybe I'll eventually be able to make something to see them. Until then, I'll have to &cbe wary after killing things&r.
Get hit by a Vengeance Spirit
Who you gonna call?
Vengeance Spirits can be contained within the &bBox of Eternal Closure&r.
To do so, I have to use a &bVengeance Focus&r on a Spirit that is near the Box.
Doing so will release a beam, freezing the Spirit in place, and the Box will suck the Spirit in and lock it inside.
Get a Dark Gem
With the &bDark Gem&r, I can start working on some of the less moral magical arts.
Blood for the Blood God
Corrupt some Life Essence
&4Blood&r is a highly powerful substance. As it is required for life, its removal allows for deadly magics.
The Dark Gem will &6corrupt Life Essence&r that it comes into contact with. By casting Life Essence onto the Gem, I can create a &bCondensed Blood&r, which can be used in bloody machines.
This process does not consume the Dark Gem.
Get a Foliot to crush a Dark Gem
Most of my previous attempts to crush Dark Gems have &cresulted in failure&r, creating only a dull, inert powder.
However, as a being of darkness itself, the &6Foliot&r is able to maintain the aura of evil, successfully creating &bCrushed Dark Gem&r dust.
Make an Exalted Crafter
The &bExalted Crafter&r allows me to &6craft items on the go&r.
The Wooden one has its own inventory, while the other uses my Ender Chest.
Being Empowered allows it to resist destruction, from outside sources as well as decay.
Exalted Crafters
Make a Blood Infusion Core
The &bBlood Infusion Core&r is the heart (almost literally) of bloody machines.
Make a Blood Infuser
The &bBlood Infuser&r allows me to extract the powers of Blood and insert them into items, creating something entirely new.

I can right-click the condensed blood I made onto the machine but I imagine that will get tedious in time. I can instead use a &5Click Machine&r to automate filling a blood tank and set the tank on top of my blood machines in auto output mode (control+right click changes the mode)
Isn't That Where Blood Is Supposed to Be?
Make a Blood Chest
The &bBlood Chest&r will &6repair damaged items using Blood&r.
This comes with a chance of &capplying curses&r.
Make an Undead Sapling
Infusing Blood into a Dead Fern has brought it to life, creating an &bUndead Sapling&r.
Empty Promises
Make a Promise
&bPromises&r are upgrades I can insert into bloody machines.
Velocity and Productivity increase speed and decrease cost, respectively.
The three tiers of &bTenacity&r &6increase the machine's tier&r, allowing for more Promises, as well as access to more recipes.
Promises
Make a Purifier
The &bPurifier&r will use Blood to &6strip Curses from items&r.
Placing a &6Blook&r inside with an enchanted item will transfer a random enchant from the item to the Blook.
Make a Pendant
The &bInvigorating Pendant&r uses Blood to &6remove negative effects&r.
The &bPrimed Pendant&r contains a Potion, and uses Blood to apply it regularly.
Pendants
Make an Effortless Ring
While the &bEffortless Ring&r is anywhere in my inventory, it will &6boost my maneuverability&r.
Make a Vengeance Pickaxe
The &bVengeance Pickaxe&r is a very powerful mining tool.
It comes pre-enchanted with &6Fortune V&r, but has a &cchance of spawning Vengeance Spirits&r when used.
Just a Burning Memory
Make a Burning GemStone
While the &bBurning GemStone&r is in my inventory, &6Vengeance Spirit attacks will cause hunger&r instead of dealing damage.
Make a Gemstone Torch
As seen with the GemStone, Vengeance Spirits dislike flame. Ironic, given where we are.
Crafting it into a &bGemstone Torch&r seems to &6entirely prevent them from spawning&r! A necessity in my mob farms.
Make a Spirit Furnace
I've discovered a way to &6reanimate Vengeance Spirits&r, though they are &chighly unstable&r.
I will have to make a cage of &6Dark Blood Brick&r, large enough to contain the mob, with the &bSpirit Furnace&r as a focal point.
Using Blood, the Spirit Furnace will &6rapidly reanimate and &nde&r&6animate Vengeance Spirits&r, generating their drops.
To set the mob, insert a &6filled Box of Eternal Closure&r.
This device is extremely powerful and is even capable of reanimating some of my most powerful enemies including bosses, the wither and anything else that was once living!
Make a Spirit Reanimator
The &bSpirit Reanimator&r technically does not reanimate the dead. Instead, it &6bring new life from it&r.
Using Blood, it will &6create Spawn Eggs&r by combining a Spirit in a Box of Eternal Closure with an Egg.
The Spirit is lost in the process.
What Is Dead May Die
Make a Piercing Vengeance Focus
These Vengeance Spirits are a serious pain; they can hurt me but I can do nothing to retaliate. At least, before now.
The beam the &bPiercing Vengeance Focus&r gives off is &6capable of killing Vengeance Spirits&r!
In addition to their normal drops, I can find &6Vengeance Essence&r, an &5incredibly powerful substance&r used in the strongest magics.
Wither Farm
inferno_quests.chapters.sanguine_sting.2: I can &bcapture the Wither's Soul&r in the Box of Eternal Closure, and then &6infinitely harvest it for Nether Stars&r in the Spirit Furnace!
Forged in souls of the damned

I've found that certain areas seem to have concentrated demonic energy that creates an unseen will upon the area. I've devised a way to imbue this will into items and infused them with the living will. The will does unfortunately deplete from the area so I'll need to make a specialized gem to contain the will and a living sword that can draw it from enemies I kill with it.
inferno_quests.chapters.sinful_sorcery.1: Sinful Sorcery
inferno_quests.chapters.sinful_sorcery.6: A major part of rituals involves drawing circles using &bChalk&r. This circle is called a &6Pentacle&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.sinful_sorcery.7: Different rituals have different patterns that must be drawn; I can consult the &6Dictionary of Spirits&r for information on each.
inferno_quests.chapters.sinful_sorcery.1: Rituals need more than just pretty circles and glowing lights. I have to give something up to receive something in return.
The &bGolden Sacrificial Bowl&r goes in the center of the circle, and holds the catalyst item.
&bSacrfical Bowls&r placed nearby (and at the same y-level) hold items that will be lost in the ritual.
Make a Chalk Brush
Chalk is surprisingly hard to clean up! The &bChalk Brush&r will help remove it easier.
Not Edible, Even by Piglins
Make Golden Chalk
With a Foliot bound, I can set them to &6crushing metal&r into a fine powder, which more readily accepts my power.
&bGolden Chalk&r is used in even more powerful pentacles.
The Colour of Magic
inferno_quests.chapters.sinful_sorcery.2: &bPurple Chalk&r contains the power of &5the End&r, allowing for &6even more powerful rituals&r.
&eOccultism&r, the art of &5binding spirits to my will&r.
My notes here will not cover everything Occultism has to offer. The rest can be found in the &bDictionary of Spirits&r.
&bOtherworld Trees&r disguise themselves as normal trees. However, that's not really a factor here.

inferno_quests.chapters.sinful_sorcery.3: &bOtherstone&r can be gathered by burning Andesite in the &6Spiritfire&r. How nostalgic!
It seems Otherstone comes from another dimension. That is, another, &onother&r, dimension. Perhaps the Spiritfire actually has some connection to it?
&6Source&r is a highly magical substance, but it is firmly bound to &oliving&r entities. To work with the &ounliving&r, it'll have to be corrupted.
The &6Spiritfire&r does the trick, converting Source Gems into &bSpirit Attuned Gems&r.
&bSpirit Attuned Crystals&r are a required component of several Pentacles.
Rend the Fat and Boil the Bones
inferno_quests.chapters.sinful_sorcery.4: A &bButcher's Knife&r allows me to &6harvest more useful materials&r from animals.
The &bTallow&r is particularly useful, as it can be melted into magical &bCandles&r required for certain rituals.
I should now have everything required to summon forth a spirit from this realm, and &6bind it to my will&r.
Finally, some payback! Trap me here will you, well now it's MY turn!
I'm not going to make the same mistake twice, however. I'll &6start small&r. A &bFoliot&r is a silly little creature, &6useful for menial labor&r and no threat to me.
Crafting my Dictionary of Spirits with the &bBook of Binding&r will &6enscribe the name of a Foliot&r into the book.
inferno_quests.chapters.sinful_sorcery.5: Now that I've mastered the basics of spirit summons and bindings, it's time for me to push the limits.
I can &6cast out a spirit&r to bind it to an extradimensional entity, &6summoning it to me&r.

This uses the &6Hedyrin's Lure&r pentacle. Upon starting the ritual, it will emit &6black particles&r. This means it is waiting for a living sacrifice: usually killing a mob, but in this case simply throwing an egg.
The &bPossessed Endermite&r would be my best bet for now. Since they eat &6End Stone&r, it will almost certainly drop some on death.
It may be adventageous for me to create a &5soul shard&r of the possessed endermites to avoid needing to resummon them.
I believe I've mastered Foliots well enough; it's time for something more powerful.
The &bDjinni&r are strong, willful spirits with &6tremendous innate magic&r.
Using the ritual &6Strigeor's Higher Binding&r, I can bind a Djinni to an item.
inferno_quests.chapters.sinful_sorcery.6: The Pentacle &bAviar's Circle&r will allow me to &6summon a known Foliot&r. This Foliot is the one bound to the Book of Binding.
Summoned spirits &cdo not last long&r. Their essence decays the longer they exist here, ending in their death.
Death for summoned spirits is more like going home, and they &6can be summoned again&r. Unfortunately for me, they do not seem to mind.
Spirits &6require a purpose&r to be summoned. A Foliot can be summoned as a Crusher or a Lumberjack or yada yada, but it can't be summoned as nothing.
Upon giving the outer Bowls the ingredients, and the center Bowl the bound &6Book of Binding&r, &bthe summon will begin&r.

inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.112: The &bVoid Worm&r is the guardian of all worlds. Defeating it would allow me to &6bind its power to my will&r, the final step to &6breaching the void&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.113: With its downfall, I can &6reach the ultimate level of research&r, and finally be free of this wretched prison!
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.114: Upon completing my T5 University I can finish the &6Eldritch Transcedence&r research and finally travel to my world through a standard nether portal.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.117: Lower-level workers &ccan only use lower-level tools&r. This includes armor, weapons, and other tools. Additionally, higher-level jobs may require higher-level tools.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.118: Colonists will specify the ones they need when requesting. This can be seen in the Clipboard.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.119: A level 2 job can obviously use a level 2 tool, but it can also use &6an enchanted level 1 tool&r. Each level of enchantment adds +1 to the tool's level. Level 5 can use any tier, with any amount of enchantments.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.122: After defeating the Bellringer and upgrading my University, I've learned to teach my minions even more advanced tasks.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.123: The &bMechanic's Hut&r can craft redstone items and other advanced items. It is also the &6only way to craft certain items&r essential for progression.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.126: There are 11 &bSkills&r that every colonist has. Each colonist has a different amount of each skill.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.127: Different jobs benefit from different skills. In the job's hire menu, it highlights its &aprimary&r and &esecondary&r skills in those colors. Higher levels of these skills provide bonuses.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.128: Workers' skills increase as they work. This speed increases with higher Intelligence, and with higher-level jobs. Max skill is limited by their home's level.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.131: &cManual labor&r, ugh. For the &bCrusher&r, I'll have one of the stronger minions handle it.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.132: The Crusher, as the name implies, crushes things. This includes Sand and Gravel, but is also &6the only way to get several required materials&r.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.135: I've noted &c4 unique and deadly illnesses&r that my minions seem susceptible to in this realm.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.136: Rather than attempting to tend to each of them myself, I've designed a &bHospital&r where Healers will cure these plagues.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.137: Each disease requires certain items to cure it. Some of the more dangerous illnesses may require research into magics to be fully addressed.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.138: &oIt is HIGHLY recommended you do not offline chunk load your colony until you have a hospital or it is possible to log back in to find your entire colony infected and unable to work!
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.140: Why your Builder is just standing there doing nothing
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.141: Sometimes, a Builder will appear to get stuck doing nothing.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.142: In final steps of building/upgrading a building, &6the Builder checks every block to make sure they're placed correctly&r. During this, they may appear to just be standing still.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.143: &cDo not cancel the build&r to restart it. The Builder will have to start over from the start, checking all the blocks again. This takes longer for larger buildings.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.144: &oHowever,&r sometimes they &lare&r stuck. This is a lot more obvious, like if a builder gets stuck in a tree etc. Just knock them down and they'll continue.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.145: &lExtremely long build times are normal for large buildings.&r It can take over an hour to upgrade buildings like the University.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.148: Builders &cdo not request all the needed blocks at once&r. They do them in batches, and then make another request later.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.149: Reason being, Builders simply cannot hold that many items in their inventory. They'll ask for what they can hold, then ask for more when they're empty.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.150: Keep an eye on your &6Clipboard&r! It'll tell you what blocks they need.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.151: Diversity is the Spice of Life
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.154: &bKnights&r are melee guards. They wear armor and use swords. They can use shields if unlocked in the University.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.155: &bArchers&r are ranged guards. They wear armor and use bows. They don't need arrows, but University research allows them to use them for more damage.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.156: &bDruids&r are support guards, that help the other two. They wear armor and will use potions you give them. They will buff allies and debuff enemies, but will not deal damage directly.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.159: Colonists &bcan be taught recipes&r, and will craft items that are requested.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.160: For instance, if a &6Builder&r needs stairs, a &6Courier&r will bring a &6Carpenter&r logs. The Carpenter will craft them into planks, then into stairs, and the Courier will bring them to the Builder.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.161: &6Different jobs can craft different things.&r You can see which recipes each job can craft in JEI.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.162: Recipes &6have to be taught&r. This is done in a tab in the job block.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.163: When teaching recipes, you can drag items from JEI. Recipes &cdo not use tags&r, they only use the exact ingredients.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.166: The &bPermissions&r tab in the Town Hall lets you set other players' relations to your colony.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.167: Add a player by their username, and you can set their &6rank&r. There are 5 default ranks, with each rank being allowed to do different things.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.168: Other players are &6neutral by default&r. Neutral players &6cannot interact with any blocks in your colony's borders&r. This also includes mobs, explosions, and the like.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.169: Turn the page, and you can add ranks and change each rank's permissions.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.170: Turn the page again, and you can set it so anyone can interact with certain blocks. You can do this by the block's id (minecraft:chest etc), or using the block's coordinates.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.173: Colonists will &bprefer walking on certain blocks&r. If you make roads out of these, they'll stick to those.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.174: Colonists can open Doors, Gates, Trapdoors, etc. They can even use Iron ones without a redstone signal! They will also use Ladders and Vines, and avoid fire, lava, and the like.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.175: At the &6University&r, you can unlock the ability for colonists to &6ride on Rails&r. They provide their own Carts, and don't need boosters. Don't confuse them with intersections though!
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.178: A quick TL;DR of the mod
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.179: &eMineColonies&r is basically Sim City, allowing you to &6build a village&r building by building, with each performing a function.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.180: Colonists will &6gather resources&r, move and store items, &6autocraft recipes&r, and more, once set up.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.181: The Lumberjack will chop trees, the Courier will bring the drops to storage. The Smelter will take ores from storage and smelt them, multiplying the output. The Cook cooks, the Fisher fishes, etc etc.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.182: Basically, think of it as an &6automation mod&r that's hidden inside a city simulator.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.184: This accursed Apple cast out Adam and Eve. It turned staves into snakes. Parted and closed the Red Sea. Eris used it to spark the Trojan War. With it, a carpenter turned water into wine.
inferno_quests.chapters.want_not.185: With the &bApple of Eden&r, my researchers can reach &6Ascendence&r. My minions will be gods.
